title: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation not accepted by the UE

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation
entities.description: Procedure for activating a dedicated EPS bearer context between UE and MME.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE to request activation of a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to MME to reject the dedicated EPS bearer context activation request.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer context being activated or rejected.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Indicates the reason for rejecting the dedicated EPS bearer context activation request.

entities.name: TFT
entities.description: Traffic Flow Template containing packet filters and operations for EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Semantic error in TFT operation
entities.description: Condition when TFT operation is other than 'Create a new TFT'.

entities.name: Syntactical error in TFT operation
entities.description: Condition when TFT operation has syntactical errors like empty packet filter list or coding mismatch.

entities.name: Semantic errors in packet filters
entities.description: Condition when packet filters have conflicting components or no uplink packet filter.

entities.name: Syntactical errors in packet filters
entities.description: Condition when packet filters have syntactical errors like duplicate identifiers or reserved values.

entities.name: T3485
entities.description: Timer used during dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: State in which MME waits for UE response to bearer activation request.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by MME after receiving reject message or aborting activation.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
Procedure includes receiving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message.
REJECT message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
REJECT message contains ESM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
REQUEST message contains TFT IE for bearer context activation.
ESM cause value #41 is triggered by semantic error in TFT operation condition.
ESM cause value #42 is triggered by syntactical error in TFT operation condition.
ESM cause value #44 is triggered by semantic errors in packet filters condition.
ESM cause value #45 is triggered by syntactical errors in packet filters condition.
Receipt of REJECT message stops timer T3485.
REJECT message processing requires MME to be in BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING state.
Receipt of REJECT message causes MME to enter BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE state.
